title: Diagnostic
desc: Understand WHY a past or in-flight promotion underperformed.
example: Why did Buy3Get1 on Outdoor Fresh Dryer Sheets 240 ct underperform in B2B?
questions: Why did Buy3Get1 on Outdoor Fresh Dryer Sheets 240 ct underperform in B2B?
Why did 15% Discount on Outdoor Fresh Dryer Sheets 160 ct miss the ROI target in B2B?
Why do B2B and Travel promotions fall furthest below the 1.50x ROI target?
Which promotions lost money, and what do they have in common?

title: Optimization
desc: Maximize ROI of an active or upcoming promotion through TPO levers.
example: How do we maximize ROI of the upcoming Q3 Festive Push?
questions: How do we maximize ROI of the upcoming Q3 Festive Push?
How to optimize spend across MT / GT / eCom for South region?
What's the optimal discount depth for Skin Care this quarter?
How to rebalance retailer incentives to improve participation?

title: Launch Planning
desc: Plan a new product launch or major promotional campaign.
example: Which 5 SKUs should we prioritize for Q3 Festive eCom launch?
questions: Which 5 SKUs should we prioritize for Q3 Festive eCom launch?
What's the optimal launch window for the Diwali Premium range?
Which regions to prioritize for the new Skincare launch?
How much trade spend to allocate to the festive launch?

title: Strategic Review
desc: Quarterly or annual trade strategy review with portfolio-level decisions.
example: Should we increase Q3 trade spend allocation to South region?
questions: Should we increase Q3 trade spend allocation to South region?
What's the optimal portfolio mix for FY26?
Where should we invest growth budget for FY26?
How to rebalance channel mix for sustainable growth?
